channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Terrence Shannon | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Terrence Shannon from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Chris Finch on Terrence Shannon, LaMelo Ball
item.description:
Chris Finch on playing Ant and LaMelo together continued:

“...You see the TJ (Shannon)/Ayo combos are really, really good. So, you know, we might just double down, play those guys together, but we'll be ready to read it as we go along.”

Chris Finch on Terrence Shannon, LaMelo Ball, Oct 7, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: LaMelo Ball on Terrence Shannon
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Chris Finch says he's still mulling whether to stagger Ant/LaMelo:

“My gut tells me I want them to be out there together. We've got guys off the bench that can bring punch, that can be handling, that could bring different things, those guys are really good together. You see the TJ (Shannon)/Ayo combos are really, really good. So, you know, we might just double down, play those guys together, but we'll be ready to read it as we go along.”

LaMelo Ball on Terrence Shannon, Oct 7, 2026. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Chris Finch on Terrence Shannon, Jaylen Clark
item.description:
‪Ryan Eichten‬: Chris Finch on what he sees for Terrence Shannon and Jaylen Clark:

“It's about creating pathways for those guys to be able to play. You might say like, isn't that the coach's job? But sometimes, you know, there's a gridlock. So we've gotta look at how we can either kind of change things around or get to a point where these guys can get a more consistent role.”

Chris Finch on Terrence Shannon, Jaylen Clark, Jun 23, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Terrence Shannon
item.description:
Rudy Gobert on Terrence Shannon's 3-point shooting:

“The whole team is behind him, telling him to let it fly. It’s great when he does that. That, with his ability to attack the rim, is a very, very dangerous weapon for us.”

Rudy Gobert on Terrence Shannon, Dec 21, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chris Hines on Terrence Shannon
item.description:
Dane Moore:Wolves summer league coach Chris Hines on Terrence Shannon Jr.:

“The kid has a talent that is energy. People don't understand that energy is a talent these days. He has his motor and he premium gas.”

Chris Hines on Terrence Shannon, Jul 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Rich Paul on Bronny James, Justin Edwards, Terrence Shannon, Rob Dillingham, Oso Ighodaro
item.description:
“But for me in my position, I’m just trying to find the best opportunity, whether it’s for Bronny, whether it’s for Rob Dillingham, whether it’s for Terrence Shannon, or Justin Edwards, or KJ Simpson, or Oso Ighodaro. Any [Klutch] guys in our class. That’s the draft.”

Rich Paul on Bronny James, Justin Edwards, Terrence Shannon, Rob Dillingham, Oso Ighodaro, Jun 20, 2024. Source: The Ringer.
